What is proved is exact oracle \(1-\alpha\) calibration at every fixed separated regular face, uniformly negligible fallback probability and \(O_{P_n}(n^{-1/2})\) finite-coordinate width, an explicit \(K=4\) changing-support diagnostic with exact limiting coverage, a \(K=4\) singleton-cell counterexample to every even symmetric max-linear probe, and a bounded oriented repair on that face. project_justification.niche: The fixed finite multinomial model permits a total semialgebraic endpoint extension, a measurable nearby-legal-base directional envelope, and common-Gaussian calibration. These ingredients give exact oracle behavior on separated faces and root-\(n\) width control without individual cell, cut-gap, or variance floors. The singleton-cell analysis shows that legality is intrinsically oriented at a binding selection-total face, but it does not resolve intersections of capacity, selection-total, and active-cut faces.
project_justification.fill: The proved contribution combines the imported sharp endpoint map with a measurable total procedure, exact separated-face oracle calibration, uniform fallback and width control, an explicit \(K=4\) stress-test array, a counterexample ruling out every even symmetric-probe reduction, and an oriented parity and finite-curvature repair on the counterexample face. No support, cut-gap, cell-mass, or variance floor, screening rule, or deterministic guard is introduced.

prose_updates.related_work: The accepted CausalSmith survivor-complier benefit result supplies the exact sharp endpoint formula and full-law sharpness; identification is imported rather than reproved. Angrist, Imbens, and Rubin (1996) support conditional instrument randomization, treatment consistency, and no defiers, while Dong and Heiler (2026) support treatment-mediated selection and outcome consistency together with covariate-specific weak selection monotonicity. The fixed \(\epsilon\) overlap bound and fixed \(m_*\) aggregate denominator floor are uniform-class strengthenings here. Fang and Santos (2019) and Hong and Li (2018) motivate derivative-aware resampling, but their generic results do not construct the required nearby legal observed laws. Frandsen and Pond (2025), Imai and Okamoto (2026), and Andrews and Guggenberger (2009) begin from regular, asymptotically linear, or standardized representations that do not resolve the present one-sided legal-face problem at vanishing scale. The available scale-free unsigned-Gaussian result applies to an even maximum and cannot provide relative lower-quantile transfer for the required non-even oriented maximum. Accordingly, the proved measurability, width, regular-face, diagnostic, negative symmetric, and singleton-face oriented results are kept separate from the sole unresolved all-array legal-relative-comparison question.
prose_updates.interpretation: The causal target remains the same-unit benefit probability \(\theta_B\), and the imported identification theorem gives its sharp identified set \(\Theta_I(p)=[L(p),U(p)]\). The empirical center, directional envelope, Gaussian critical value, and rectangle are observed-law procedures; they do not define the causal target. At separated regular faces the rectangle has exact oracle Gaussian calibration. Uniformly over the maintained class, its fallback event is negligible and its finite coordinate widths are root-\(n\) on the complementary event. The explicit \(K=4\) diagnostic also has exact limiting coverage, the singleton-cell certificate rules out every even symmetric-probe proof, and the oriented ray repairs that single face. These facts do not imply uniform coverage over all changing-support and simultaneous tied-face arrays; that implication is precisely the unresolved legal-relative-comparison question.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The explicit legal \(K=4\) singleton-cell construction proves that no even functional \(\max_\nu|a_\nu^{\mathsf T}z|\) lying below the legal envelope can dominate all nearby endpoint increments. A bounded oriented ray and an explicit survivor-to-never-selected transfer repair parity and finite curvature on that face. Globally, intersections of raw-capacity zeros, selection-total ties, and tied lower or upper cuts permit cancellations among numerator, denominator, and cut derivatives, so pointwise domination of every required oriented row by the full legal envelope is unproved. The legal donor transfers change both outcome margins, and a complete latent response-type transfer with row-by-row covariance traction is also unavailable. Consequently relative lower-quantile transfer for the non-even Gaussian maximum and the exact-zero-scale local-flatness branch remain unproved. The legal-relative-comparison question is therefore the sole all-array inferential target, and all-array uniform joint coverage is not established.
prose_updates.honest_scope: Sharp identification is imported from the accepted parent. This note proves measurability of the total procedure, exact oracle \(1-\alpha\) coverage at fixed separated regular faces, uniformly negligible fallback probability and \(O_{P_n}(n^{-1/2})\) finite-coordinate width, the stated \(K=4\) changing-support diagnostic, a legal singleton-cell counterexample to every even symmetric-probe reduction, and a bounded oriented repair on that singleton face. It does not prove global simultaneous-face pointwise domination, complete latent transfer with covariance traction, relative non-even lower-quantile validity, the exact-zero-scale branch, or uniform joint coverage over arbitrary triangular arrays. The legal-relative-comparison question is the sole all-array inferential target. No individual support, survivor-cell, cut-gap, or variance floor and no screening or deterministic guard is imposed.
